title: Gold Steady as Traders Assess Impact of Hormuz Flare-Up on Rates
summary: Gold moved in a narrow range as traders assessed the impact of a reported Iranian attack in the Strait of Hormuz on the Federal Reserve’s path for interest rates.

title: Oil Gains, Treasuries Hold Losses Before Jobs Data: Markets Wrap
summary: Oil rose as prospects for a lasting agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remained elusive. Treasuries held their losses ahead of the key US jobs data report.

Anwar’s Daughter Takes Leave from Party Leadership Amid Setbacks
summary: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s daughter has sought to relinquish her role as deputy president of his party, more than a year after her election fueled accusations of nepotism and exposed deep divisions within the ruling coalition.

title: Fujifilm Shares Tumble by a Record After Earnings Disappoint
summary: Fujifilm Holdings Corp. shares tumbled by the most on record in Tokyo trading after the medical equipment maker reported first-quarter results that fell short of expectations.

title: Iran Seeks to Bar US Ships as Deal With Oman Advances
summary: Iran will seek to bar US and Israeli ships from the Strait of Hormuz and require compensation from hostile countries before they’re allowed to use it, according to local media reports on a proposed Iran-Oman deal. Bloomberg's Michael Heath reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
